title: Agreement of specified compact-support site comparisons
statement: For a finite commutative ring $R$ and any compactification $c$ of a scheme morphism, the natural isomorphism fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso [def-sp-fixed-compact-support-comparison] equals compactSupportSiteComparison [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison], as natural isomorphisms from pro-etale compact support of the comparison image to comparison of ordinary etale compact support on $D^+$.

source.place: Paragraph 3: ordinary dualizing objects for a closed affine embedding and site realization

proof.text: Expand both canonical comparisons into their exact open-extension factor and proper direct-image counit mate. properOpenSiteExtensionIso is the plus derived natural isomorphism of the same underived open-extension comparison used by the fixed comparison.

Use compatibility of termwise exact derived functors and their natural isomorphisms with the inclusion D+ into D. Move these inclusion comparisons across the proper factor by naturality of rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. The remaining proper factor on both sides is the same specified fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus, so componentwise equality proves equality of natural isomorphisms. The argument has no nonemptiness hypothesis.
